laws.name: Fossil fuels first
laws.description: Prioritise oil, gas and coal production and low energy prices.

laws.name: Balanced energy mix
laws.description: Market-led mix of fossil, nuclear and renewable sources.

laws.name: Nuclear expansion
laws.description: State support for building nuclear power.

laws.name: Nuclear phase-out
laws.description: Close nuclear plants on a fixed timetable and expand renewables.

laws.name: Green transition
laws.description: Binding emissions targets and heavy renewable investment.
